verdict.rationale: Veriff's public API covers the core verification lifecycle: creating sessions, collecting media with your own front-end, polling decisions, and receiving webhooks. That core is also reachable via a Postman collection and biometric liveness over the API. However, several capabilities appear only in the Customer Portal: manual session review, user-defined statuses (which the API learns about only via a webhook), team and admin management, and PDF export. Missing for 10: API equivalents for manual review/decisioning, adding user-defined statuses, team/user administration and PDF export, plus a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404).
